title: 2026 北京马拉松 比赛路线 — official static course map and elevation panel
publisher: 北京马拉松组织委员会 (Beijing Marathon Organising Committee)
claims: The organiser's 比赛路线 page displays a 1,683 × 2,381 JPG headed 2026中国银行北京马拉松暨全国马拉松锦标赛 / BANK OF CHINA BEIJING MARATHON & NATIONAL MARATHON CHAMPIONSHIPS; its link 点击查看下载高清路线 points to https://pub.mararun.com/cms/pic/BJCN/28c34fc407162d6aafa06ce2a015384c.jpg.

The map marks START at Tiananmen Square and FINISH on Landscape Avenue at the Olympic Park, includes a 21.0975 km half-marathon marker, and carries a 路线海拔 Course Elevation panel whose y-axis runs 0–100 m and x-axis runs 0–42.195 km.

The elevation panel's footer reads 此海拔数据仅供参考; the image prints no cumulative ascent, cumulative descent, maximum/minimum elevation or percentage gradient, so those figures remain unpublished. The header identifies the 2026 edition, and no 2027 course map is linked from that page.
